text: Switch off power at the breaker panel and wait 2 minutes before installing your thermostat. Full circuit sizing requirements for the TH-40 are listed in the installation manual.

The Cordwell TH-40 smart thermostat requires a C-wire (common wire) for continuous power. If your existing wiring has no C-wire, install the included power adapter kit at the furnace control board before mounting the thermostat.
The TH-40 requires a 15 amp circuit breaker. Mount the TH-40 thermostat on an interior wall at a height of 52 inches, away from direct sunlight, drafts, and supply vents.

To pair the TH-40 with wifi, hold the MENU button for five seconds until the wifi icon blinks, then select your network from the list on the thermostat screen. The TH-40 supports 2.4 GHz networks only and will not detect 5 GHz networks.
If the TH-40 drops its wifi connection repeatedly, confirm the thermostat is within 30 feet of the router and update the thermostat firmware to version 2.4.1 or later from the settings menu.
The Cordwell GD-200 garage door opener uses a 0.75 horsepower DC motor and includes a battery backup rated for 36 open and close cycles during a power outage.
To program a GD-200 remote, press and release the LEARN button on the motor unit, then press the remote button within 30 seconds. The opener light flashes once to confirm the remote is programmed.
Cordwell WeatherGuard DS-12 deck stain covers 350 square feet per gallon on smooth wood. Allow 4 hours of dry time before light foot traffic and 24 hours before replacing furniture.
To start a return through the website, sign in to your Cordwell account and open your order history. Print the prepaid label from the online portal and drop the package at any carrier location.

Online orders may be returned within 90 days of delivery. A receipt or order confirmation email is required for all returns, and refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days.
Assembly of the Cordwell PK-8 pergola requires two people and takes approximately 6 hours. Anchor the posts to a concrete surface using the included expansion bolts before attaching the canopy beams.
The Cordwell SL-30 LED shop light produces 4400 lumens at a color temperature of 5000K. Mounting chains and ceiling hooks are included in the box, and units can be daisy-chained up to six fixtures.
The Cordwell SP-10 smart plug supports a maximum load of 1800 watts and is rated for indoor use only. Do not use the SP-10 with space heaters above the rated load.
The Cordwell FX-55 kitchen faucet has a flow rate of 1.8 gallons per minute and uses a ceramic disc cartridge. The cartridge is covered by the limited lifetime drip-free guarantee.
